mclaren.about: One of Formula 1's most successful constructors, McLaren was founded by New Zealander Bruce McLaren in 1963. The Woking-based outfit has won 8 Constructors' Championships and produced iconic champions including Ayrton Senna and Mika Häkkinen.

ferrari.about: The oldest and most storied team in Formula 1, Scuderia Ferrari has competed in every World Championship season since 1950. With 16 Constructors' titles, the Prancing Horse is the most successful constructor in the sport's history.

red_bull.about: Red Bull Racing transformed from a marketing exercise into Formula 1's dominant force, winning four consecutive titles from 2010-2013 with Sebastian Vettel. Their partnership with Adrian Newey produced some of the sport's most technically advanced cars.

mercedes.about: Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS achieved the most dominant era in Formula 1 history, claiming eight consecutive Constructors' Championships from 2014 to 2021. Their hybrid-era dominance powered Lewis Hamilton to six of his record-equalling seven World Drivers' titles.

aston_martin.about: Rebranded as Aston Martin in 2021 after Lawrence Stroll's acquisition of the Racing Point team, the Silverstone-based outfit has invested heavily in a new factory and wind tunnel. Their works partnership with Honda from 2026 signals serious championship ambitions.

alpine.about: Alpine represents Renault's third incarnation as a works Formula 1 entrant, rebranded in 2021. The Enstone factory, which previously produced world championship-winning cars as Benetton and Renault, carries a rich heritage dating back to Michael Schumacher's first two titles.

williams.about: Founded by Sir Frank Williams and Patrick Head, Williams Racing won seven Constructors' Championships between 1980 and 1997, making it one of the sport's most successful teams. Under new ownership and team principal James Vowles, the team is on an ambitious rebuild.

rb.fullName: Visa Cash App Racing Bulls F1 Team
rb.about: Based in Faenza, Italy and operating under the Red Bull umbrella, Racing Bulls (formerly Toro Rosso, then AlphaTauri) serves as the junior team feeding talent to Red Bull Racing. Their Italian factory has a history stretching back to the Minardi era.

haas.about: Haas became the first American constructor to enter Formula 1 in over 30 years when they debuted in 2016. Founded by industrialist Gene Haas, the team operates out of Banbury, UK with technical support from Ferrari, and achieved a best finish of fifth in the Constructors' Championship in 2018 and 2022.

sauber.fullName: Stake F1 Team Kick Sauber (→ Audi 2026)
sauber.about: The Hinwil-based team, originally founded by Peter Sauber in 1993, is undergoing a major transformation as it prepares to become the Audi works team. With Mattia Binotto overseeing the transition, the Swiss outfit combines decades of F1 heritage with the backing of a major automotive manufacturer.

cadillac.about: Cadillac joined Formula 1 as the eleventh constructor in 2026, fulfilling General Motors' long-standing ambition to return to the pinnacle of motorsport. Backed by the iconic American brand, the team made history as the first new constructor to enter the championship since Haas in 2016.
